final_answer.key_evidence_summary: Complaint side first: ts-gateway-service logs repeatedly show 'RoundRobinLoadBalancer : No servers available for service: ts-preserve-service' (20:56:07-20:57:23), and alerts record 20x HTTPError('503 Server Error: Service Unavailable') on POST /api/v1/preserveservice/preserve. Object layer: the pods listing shows every other train-ticket pod Running 2/2 with 0 restarts, but NO ts-preserve-service pod exists at all; endpoints/ts-preserve-service is '<none>'; an active TCP probe on the port its own Service declares (14568) fails from worker-01, worker-02 and worker-03. Workload state: the deployments listing has the single outlier row 'ts-preserve-service 0/0 0 0' while all other deployments are 1/1. Mechanism event (events surface): '4m58s Normal ScalingReplicaSet deployment/ts-preserve-service Scaled down replica set ts-preserve-service-6bccdc5454 to 0 from 1'. Config confirmation: the deployment YAML shows spec.replicas: 0 with generation 2, while kubectl.kubernetes.io/last-applied-configuration still records "replicas":1 -- proving a 1->0 scale-down, not a zero-replica template. Service selector app=ts-preserve-service and port 14568 match the pod template, so selector/port mismatch and gateway misroute are excluded; the only break is the emptied replica count, which drains Endpoints and leaves the gateway with zero available instances.

apiVersion: apps/v1
kind: Deployment
metadata:
  namespace: train-ticket
  name: ts-preserve-service
spec:
  selector:
    matchLabels:
      app: ts-preserve-service
  replicas: 1
  template:
    metadata:
      labels:
        app: ts-preserve-service
    spec:
      containers:
      - name: ts-preserve-service
        image: ghcr.io/sregym/ts-preserve-service:latest
        imagePullPolicy: IfNotPresent
        env:
        - name: SPRING_MAIN_ALLOW_CIRCULAR_REFERENCES
          value: 'true'
        - name: NODE_IP
          valueFrom:
            fieldRef:
              fieldPath: status.hostIP
        envFrom:
        - configMapRef:
            name: nacos
        - configMapRef:
            name: rabbitmq
        ports:
        - containerPort: 14568
        resources:
          requests:
            cpu: 200m
            memory: 350Mi
          limits:
            cpu: 500m
            memory: 512Mi
        readinessProbe:
          tcpSocket:
            port: 14568
          initialDelaySeconds: 60
          periodSeconds: 10
          timeoutSeconds: 5
---
apiVersion: v1
kind: Service
metadata:
  namespace: train-ticket
  name: ts-preserve-service
spec:
  ports:
  - name: http
    port: 14568
  selector:
    app: ts-preserve-service
